name: half-kneeling-pallof-press
instructions:
1. Assume a half kneeling position and attach a handle to a cable stack at chest height.
2. Hold the handle to your chest and assume a hip width stance with one hip in flexion and the other in extension.
3. Press the handle horizontally to extension as you exhale.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
